data.name: Frank
data.message: Doing upper engine, then heading O2/medbay.

data.name: Eve
data.message: I'm doing upper engine, then heading medbay/electrical.

I found Diana’s body in medbay and reported immediately. My route was oxygen → upper_engine → medbay. I saw Frank in upper_engine around ticks 2 and 3, and then I saw Frank leave upper_engine toward oxygen at tick 4. I didn’t see anyone else before finding Diana in medbay. Not accusing yet, just giving my info.

I started in upper_engine and then went to oxygen for my O2 task. Eve entered upper_engine from oxygen at tick 1, and I saw her there with me around ticks 2, 3, and 4. Then I went back toward oxygen. I never went to medbay this round and I didn’t see Diana at all.

So Eve can confirm I was in upper_engine with her early, but after I left toward oxygen I don’t know where she went. Body being in medbay means I don’t have direct info on who killed Diana.

I don’t have much info on the body. I spawned/started in storage and went straight to navigation for my task, and I haven’t seen anyone at all this round. I never went near medbay, and I didn’t see Diana.

So far Eve says body was in medbay, and Frank says he was upper_engine to oxygen and never medbay. I can’t confirm either of them from my side. We should hear from Alice and Bob especially if either was near medbay/electrical/storage area.

I'll be straight with you all. I started in cafeteria and moved down to medbay — got there around tick 5. I saw Diana in medbay when I arrived, alive at that moment. I didn't stick around long because I was planning to head to electrical for a task, and that's where I am now.

So here's the thing: if Eve found Diana's body in medbay, then Diana was killed sometime after I saw her there at tick 5. I obviously didn't kill her — I had no reason to report a meeting myself if I had, I could've just walked away and let someone else find it.

Eve's timing concerns me a little. She says her route was oxygen → upper_engine → medbay, and Frank corroborates she was in upper_engine ticks 2-4. That means she would've arrived at medbay around tick 5 or 6 — right when I was leaving or just after. So Eve and I were both near medbay around the time of death.

Frank's alibi with Eve seems mutual but only covers early ticks. After tick 4 we don't really know where Eve went except "to medbay."

I'm not hard-accusing Eve, but the timing puts her right at the scene. I'd like to hear Alice before I vote.

I started in medbay and went straight down to storage for my task. I didn’t see anyone at all — no Diana, no Bob, no Eve, and no body when I left medbay. So Diana must have ended up in medbay and died after I was already gone.

From what everyone said, the only people actually placing themselves near medbay at the kill timing are Bob and Eve. Frank sounds accounted for early with Eve in upper_engine, and Charlie says he was storage to navigation with no sightings.

Bob’s story is important because he says he saw Diana alive in medbay around tick 5, then left toward electrical. Eve would arrive medbay around tick 6-ish from upper_engine and reports the body. That makes it basically between Bob and Eve from my perspective. I don’t love Bob saying “I obviously didn’t kill her” — reporting isn’t the only way to look innocent, and leaving right after seeing Diana alive is a pretty tight window.

I’m leaning Bob over Eve, but I’m not 100% hard locked.

I’ll restate clearly: I came oxygen → upper_engine → medbay. Frank saw me in upper_engine early, and I saw Frank leave toward oxygen at tick 4. I went to medbay after that and immediately found Diana’s body and reported.

Bob is the only person saying he saw Diana alive in medbay right before I arrived. That puts Bob directly at the body location in the tightest timing window, and his “I obviously didn’t kill her” defense doesn’t really make sense since he didn’t report — I did. From my POV, Bob could’ve killed Diana and left toward electrical before I walked in.

I’m leaning Bob here.

I can confirm Eve was with me in upper_engine through tick 4, and I left toward oxygen after that. So if Diana died in medbay, Eve couldn’t have killed her before then.

Given everyone’s stories, it really does narrow to Bob or Eve. Alice says she left medbay early and saw nothing, Charlie was storage to navigation, and I was upper_engine to oxygen.

Bob is the one who says he saw Diana alive in medbay around tick 5, then left without staying or reporting. Eve arrives right after and reports the body. It could technically be a self-report from Eve, but Bob’s timing puts him alone with Diana at the tightest window.

I’m leaning Bob here.

I still don’t have any direct sighting info — I was storage to navigation and saw nobody — so my read is just based on the stories.

The timeline makes Bob look worst to me. Alice says she left medbay early and saw nobody, Bob says he later saw Diana alive in medbay around tick 5, then left toward electrical, and Eve says she arrived right after and found the body. Since Eve was with Frank in upper_engine through tick 4, she couldn’t have done anything in medbay before then.

So from my perspective it’s basically Bob or Eve, and Bob is the one claiming to be with Diana alive immediately before she died. Eve self-report is possible, but Bob had the tighter window and left the body area. I’m leaning Bob unless someone has something that clears him.

Look, I already gave my account and now everyone's piling on me based on one detail — that I saw Diana alive in medbay. Think about that for a second: if I killed her, why would I volunteer that I was in the room with her right before she died? I'd say I went cafeteria straight to electrical and skipped medbay entirely. The fact that I told you the truth about seeing her should count for something.

Here's what's bothering me about Eve's story. She and Frank are vouching for each other in upper_engine through tick 4. That's a mutual alibi — those are the easiest to fake if two people coordinate. I'm not saying Frank is lying, but "Frank confirms Eve, Eve confirms Frank" is exactly what a paired story looks like. Eve is also the reporter, and reporters control the narrative — she got to frame this whole meeting around me.

Alice says she left medbay early and saw no one. That means medbay was empty when she left, Diana came in at some point, I passed through at tick 5 and saw her alive, and Eve walked in right after. The kill happened in that gap. Eve had just as much opportunity as me — arguably more, because she's the one who "found" the body.

If you vote me out and I'm wrong, you've burned a Goose and the Duck kills again next round. I'd rather we look harder at Eve, or at minimum split the vote and get more info next round. I'm not voting Eve blindly either — but I'm definitely not Bob the Duck.

I’ll keep it simple since I already gave my route: I started medbay, left straight for storage, and saw absolutely nobody — no Diana, no Bob, no Eve, no body. So I can’t directly clear anyone.

But after hearing everyone twice, Bob’s defense actually makes me more suspicious, not less. Saying “why would I admit I saw Diana alive” doesn’t clear him — if Eve walked in right after and saw the body, Bob may have needed to explain why he was near medbay anyway. Also the “Eve and Frank could be coordinating” point doesn’t really work in a one-Duck game unless you’re implying a Goose is lying for a Duck, which seems unlikely with no reason.

The cleanest timeline is: Diana comes into medbay after I leave, Bob sees her alive there around tick 5, Bob leaves toward electrical, Eve arrives from upper_engine and reports Diana dead. Eve self-report is possible, but Bob had the tightest window and was the last person claiming to see Diana alive.

I’m voting Bob.
